summary: Verified backend event-loop-blocking fixes (round: syntax-gate + deploy_readiness offload). Ran the full requested pytest set (46 tests across 11 files) — all 46 passed in 59.71s. Also confirmed source-level: services/local_tools.py:916 now wraps _run_syntax_check via `await asyncio.to_thread(_run_syntax_check, content=content, file_path=path, ext=_ext)` inside write_repo_file's syntax gate, and services/deploy_readiness.py:80 now uses `ws = await asyncio.to_thread(_workspace_state)`. Regression suites (connect flow refinement, connect bridge delay, admin connect diagnostic, github_app_project_add, business_owner_gates, no_edit_deadend_guard, mode_auto_escalation, narration_leak_strip) all still green — no regression from touching services/local_tools.py. Backend-only scope as requested; no frontend testing performed.
critical_code_review_comments: Acknowledged (per request, NOT re-reported as a new bug): services/cto_projects_helpers.py::_sh() still runs sync subprocess.run for git clone/revert/push (up to 90s/call, 15+ call sites in routers/cto_projects.py's _run_rollback_with_git and ship/commit flow) inside FastAPI BackgroundTasks (same event loop). Same class of bug as the syntax gate — intentionally deferred by founder; will need the same asyncio.to_thread offload (or a real worker) in a follow-up round.

Acknowledged flagged (deferred): services/qa_matrix.py verification-pipeline subprocesses and services/health_coverage_scan.py's asyncio.create_task(run_coverage_scan) call site — both scheduled onto the running loop; long-running by design so a real thread/process worker is the correct fix, not just to_thread.
Nit: the >2000ms log line downstream of the offloaded gate is now logger.info as intended — good; ensure any Prometheus/observability that watched for the old logger.warning marker is updated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This round fixed 2 obvious event-loop-blocking offenders (write_repo_file syntax gate + deploy_readiness workspace_state) via asyncio.to_thread. Next round will likely tackle the flagged services/cto_projects_helpers.py::_sh() call sites (rollback + ship/commit paths) — that fix has a much larger blast radius (15+ call sites, safety-critical git-write path) so expect a dedicated round with focused mocked BackgroundTask event-loop-starvation tests analogous to test_event_loop_not_starved_2026_09_02.py.
rca of the issue: Original 'Loop status error timeout of 60000ms exceeded' symptom root-caused to write_repo_file calling _run_syntax_check synchronously — that helper runs subprocess.run for py_compile/node --check/tsc --noEmit (up to 10–15s per file), which on the single asyncio event loop starves concurrent requests including the frontend's GET /loop/{id}/status poll (60s axios timeout). Fix: offload via asyncio.to_thread so the loop stays free. Verified by 2 new tests that drive the REAL write_repo_file with a mocked slow subprocess and assert a concurrent heartbeat/poll task ticks without gaps.
